summary: Dell Alienware X17 R1 System State Baseline
detected_fault: Stuttering (game freezes for 2 seconds or so, then moves on, then freezes again in about 30 seconds)
suggested_solution: Uninstall and reinstall the NVIDIA GeForce drivers to ensure they are up-to-date and compatible.
Check for any background processes that may be interfering with the system and consider disabling or uninstalling them if necessary.
Verify that the Dell SupportAssist application is not running in the background and consider uninstalling it if it is causing issues.
